Implement a function `compile_proposal_draft` that compiles all structured artifacts into a proposal draft. The UI displays a red indicator when the API key is missing or invalid.
The indicator is visible on the main dashboard or settings page.

Tasks.Description: Create a function `check_api_key_status` that takes the API key as input, validates it using the OpenAI API, and returns a boolean indicating its validity. Input: API key (string). Design a function `display_indicator_on_dashboard` that ensures the indicator is visible on the main dashboard or settings page. Input: None. Transformation: Render the indicator in the UI at the specified location. Output: None.

E002.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want the system to validate my API key upon entry so that I can ensure it is correct and functional for AI calls.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system checks the validity of the API key upon entry.
A success message is displayed if the key is valid.
An error message is displayed if the key is invalid, with suggestions for correction.

Tasks.Description: Create a function `validate_api_key(api_key: str) -> bool` that takes an API key as input, sends a test request to the OpenAI API, and returns True if the API key is valid and the request is successful, otherwise returns False.

Develop a function `display_message(is_valid: bool) -> None` that takes a boolean input indicating the validity of the API key. If True, the function displays a success message to the user. If False, it displays an error message with suggestions for correction.

Implement a function `store_api_key_locally(api_key: str) -> None` that stores the API key locally in a secure manner if it is valid. This function should be called after successful validation of the API key.

Integrate the above functions into the UI workflow such that when a user enters their API key, the system automatically validates it using `validate_api_key`, displays the appropriate message with `display_message`, stores the key with `store_api_key_locally` if valid, and updates the UI state with `update_ui_state`.

E002.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want an interface to manage my API key so that I can update or delete it as needed.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The UI provides options to update the existing API key.
The UI allows for the deletion of the API key with a confirmation prompt.
Changes to the API key are reflected immediately in the system's status indicators.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a Python function `get_api_key_status()` that checks the presence of an API key locally. Input: None. Transformation: Check the local storage for the existence of an API key. Output: Boolean value indicating the presence (True) or absence (False) of the API key.

Develop a Python function `update_api_key(new_key)` to update the existing API key. Input: `new_key` (string) representing the new API key. Transformation: Validate the new key format and store it locally, replacing the old key if it exists. Output: Boolean indicating success (True) or failure (False) of the update operation.

Create a Python function `delete_api_key()` that deletes the existing API key. Input: None. Transformation: Remove the API key from local storage after user confirmation. Output: Boolean indicating success (True) or failure (False) of the deletion operation.

Implement a Python function `confirm_deletion()` to handle user confirmation for API key deletion. Input: None. Transformation: Display a confirmation prompt to the user and capture their response. Output: Boolean indicating user's confirmation (True) or cancellation (False).

Design a Python function `update_status_indicator()` that updates the UI status indicator based on the presence of an API key. Input: Boolean value from `get_api_key_status()`. Transformation: Set the UI indicator to green if the API key is present and red if absent. Output: None, but the UI is updated to reflect the current state.

Integrate all functions into the Flask application, ensuring that UI elements trigger the appropriate functions for updating, deleting, and displaying the status of the API key. Input: User interactions from the UI. Transformation: Call the relevant functions based on user actions. Output: Updated UI reflecting the current state of the API key.

Test the entire API key management workflow to ensure all acceptance criteria are met, including updating, deleting, and immediate status reflection. Input: Test cases simulating user interactions. Transformation: Execute test cases and verify expected outcomes. Output: Test results indicating pass or fail for each acceptance criterion.

E003.Epic Description: Create a system that uses AI-driven prompts to ask clarifying questions and capture necessary information. User responses should be logged in a conversation log stored locally, with AI generating questions until sufficient information is collected.
E003.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to initiate a session with AI-driven prompts so that I can start capturing necessary information through a guided conversation.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system provides an option to start a new AI-driven prompt session.
Upon initiation, the system begins with a default introductory question.
The session is logged with a unique identifier for future reference.

Tasks.Description: Develop a function `start_prompt_session()` that initializes a new AI-driven prompt session. Input: None. Transformation: Generate a unique session identifier and initiate a session with a default introductory question. Output: A dictionary containing the session ID and the first question.

Implement a function `generate_unique_session_id()` that creates a unique identifier for each session. Input: None. Transformation: Use a combination of timestamp and random number to ensure uniqueness. Output: A string representing the unique session ID.

Create a function `log_session_start(session_id, question)` that logs the start of a session. Input: Session ID and the introductory question. Transformation: Write the session ID and question to a local conversation log file. Output: Confirmation of successful logging.

Design a function `get_introductory_question()` that retrieves the default introductory question. Input: None. Transformation: Access a predefined question from a configuration or database. Output: A string containing the introductory question.

Set up a local storage mechanism `initialize_conversation_log()` to store conversation logs. Input: None. Transformation: Create or verify the existence of a local file or database table to store session logs. Output: Confirmation of storage readiness.

E003.Epic Description: Create a system that uses AI-driven prompts to ask clarifying questions and capture necessary information. User responses should be logged in a conversation log stored locally, with AI generating questions until sufficient information is collected.
E003.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want the AI to generate clarifying questions based on my responses so that I can provide all necessary information efficiently.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The AI generates a new question based on the previous response.
Questions are relevant and aim to fill gaps in information.
The system allows the CREATOR to request a repeat or clarification of the question.

Tasks.Description: Develop a function `generate_clarifying_question(previous_response: str) -> str` that uses the OpenAI API to generate a new question based on the previous response. The input is a string containing the user's last response, and the output is a string containing a new, relevant question aimed at filling information gaps.

Create a function `log_conversation_entry(question: str, response: str) -> None` that logs each question and response pair locally. The inputs are strings for the question and the response, and there is no output as it writes to a local storage file.

Implement a function `check_information_sufficiency(conversation_log: List[Dict[str, str]]) -> bool` that evaluates if sufficient information has been collected. The input is a list of dictionaries representing the conversation log, and the output is a boolean indicating whether the information is complete.

Design a function `handle_repeat_or_clarification_request(current_question: str) -> str` that allows the CREATOR to request a repeat or clarification of the current question. The input is the current question string, and the output is a string with either the repeated question or a clarified version.

Develop a function `store_conversation_locally(conversation_log: List[Dict[str, str]]) -> None` that saves the entire conversation log to a local file. The input is a list of dictionaries representing the conversation log, and there is no output as it writes to a local file.

Create a function `initialize_conversation() -> List[Dict[str, str]]` that initializes and returns an empty conversation log. This function has no inputs and outputs an empty list of dictionaries to start the logging process.

E003.Epic Description: Create a system that uses AI-driven prompts to ask clarifying questions and capture necessary information. User responses should be logged in a conversation log stored locally, with AI generating questions until sufficient information is collected.
E003.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want my responses to be logged in a conversation log stored locally so that I can review and edit them if necessary.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Each response is appended to a local conversation log in real-time.
The log is accessible for review and editing during and after the session.
The log is stored in a format that is easy to export and share.

Tasks.Description: Create a function `initialize_conversation_log()` that initializes a new conversation log file locally. Input: None. Transformation: Create a new file with a unique session identifier. Output: File path of the initialized log.

Develop a function `append_response_to_log(response, log_path)` that appends each user response to the conversation log in real-time. Input: User response (string), log file path (string). Transformation: Open the log file, append the response with a timestamp. Output: None.

Implement a function `load_conversation_log(log_path)` that loads the conversation log for review and editing. Input: Log file path (string). Transformation: Read the log file content. Output: List of responses with timestamps.

Create a function `edit_conversation_log(log_path, response_index, new_response)` that allows editing of a specific response in the log. Input: Log file path (string), index of the response to edit (integer), new response text (string). Transformation: Modify the specified response in the log file. Output: None.

Develop a function `export_conversation_log(log_path, export_format)` that exports the conversation log in a specified format (e.g., JSON, CSV). Input: Log file path (string), export format (string). Transformation: Convert the log content to the specified format. Output: Exported file path.

E003.Epic Description: Create a system that uses AI-driven prompts to ask clarifying questions and capture necessary information. User responses should be logged in a conversation log stored locally, with AI generating questions until sufficient information is collected.
E003.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to be notified when sufficient information has been collected so that I can review the session and make any final adjustments.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system notifies the CREATOR when the AI determines that sufficient information has been collected.
The CREATOR can review the entire conversation log before finalizing.
The CREATOR can make edits to the log and mark the session as complete.

Tasks.Description: Develop a function `check_information_sufficiency` that takes as input the conversation log and a predefined set of criteria for sufficiency. It uses the OpenAI API to analyze the log and returns a boolean indicating whether sufficient information has been collected.

Create a function `notify_creator` that is triggered when `check_information_sufficiency` returns true. This function sends a notification to the CREATOR, which could be a desktop notification or an email, indicating that sufficient information has been collected.

Implement a function `load_conversation_log` that retrieves the entire conversation log from the local storage. The input is the session ID, and the output is the complete conversation log in a readable format for the CREATOR to review.

Develop a function `edit_conversation_log` that allows the CREATOR to make edits to the conversation log. The inputs are the session ID and the proposed changes. The function updates the log in local storage and returns a confirmation of the update.

Create a function `mark_session_complete` that allows the CREATOR to mark the session as complete after reviewing and editing the conversation log. The input is the session ID, and the output is a status update in the system indicating the session is finalized.

E003.Epic Description: Create a system that uses AI-driven prompts to ask clarifying questions and capture necessary information. User responses should be logged in a conversation log stored locally, with AI generating questions until sufficient information is collected.
E003.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to export the conversation log to a preferred format so that I can use it in other applications or share it with others.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system provides options to export the log in formats such as PDF and Excel.
The export function is accessible from the session review screen.
The exported file retains the structure and content of the conversation log.

Tasks.Description: Design a function 'export_log_to_pdf' that takes the conversation log as input, transforms it into a PDF format, and outputs a PDF file. Ensure the structure and content of the conversation log are retained in the PDF.

Design a function 'export_log_to_excel' that takes the conversation log as input, transforms it into an Excel format, and outputs an Excel file. Ensure the structure and content of the conversation log are retained in the Excel file.
Implement a user interface component on the session review screen that allows users to select their preferred export format (PDF or Excel) and initiate the export process.

Develop a function 'generate_conversation_log' that retrieves the conversation data from the local storage, ensuring it is formatted correctly for export functions. The input is a session identifier, and the output is the structured conversation log.
Create a function 'save_exported_file' that takes the exported file and a user-defined file path as inputs, and saves the file to the specified location on the user's local machine.
Write unit tests for 'export_log_to_pdf' and 'export_log_to_excel' functions to ensure they correctly transform and retain the structure and content of the conversation log.
Conduct integration testing to verify that the export functionality is accessible from the session review screen and that the exported files are correctly formatted and saved.

E004.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to use a voice intake UI to speak my vision so that it can be transcribed live into an editable text area for further processing.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system provides a local desktop UI for voice input.
The spoken vision is transcribed live into text.
The transcribed text is editable before submission.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a local desktop application UI using Python and Flask that allows users to initiate voice input. Input: User interaction to start voice recording. Transformation: Capture voice input through the microphone. Output: Audio stream data.

Integrate a voice-to-text transcription service using OpenAI API to convert the audio stream into text in real-time. Input: Audio stream data from the microphone. Transformation: Use OpenAI's NLP capabilities to transcribe spoken words into text. Output: Transcribed text data.

Develop a feature within the desktop application that displays the transcribed text in a text area, allowing for live updates as the transcription occurs. Input: Transcribed text data. Transformation: Display text in a UI component that updates in real-time. Output: Visible text area with live transcription.

Implement functionality to make the transcribed text editable within the text area before submission. Input: Transcribed text displayed in the text area. Transformation: Allow user edits and modifications to the text. Output: Editable text area with user-modified text.

Create a submission mechanism that captures the final edited text for further processing. Input: User-modified text from the editable text area. Transformation: Capture and store the final version of the text. Output: Finalized text data ready for further processing.

Ensure the application can handle errors gracefully, such as microphone access issues or transcription service failures, and provide user feedback. Input: Potential error conditions during voice capture or transcription. Transformation: Detect errors and provide user-friendly error messages. Output: Error notifications and suggestions for resolution.

Story Acceptance Criteria: The UI provides a clear path for obtaining an OpenAI API key.
The API key is stored locally and securely.
The UI indicates the presence of the API key with a red/green state.

Tasks.Description: Design the UI component for managing the OpenAI API key. Inputs: None. Transformation: Create a wireframe for the UI that includes fields for entering and displaying the API key, and indicators for the key's presence status. Outputs: Wireframe design document.

Implement the UI component to allow users to input their OpenAI API key. Inputs: User-entered API key. Transformation: Develop a form in the UI where users can enter their API key. Outputs: Captured API key from user input.

Develop a function to securely store the OpenAI API key locally. Inputs: API key from user input. Transformation: Encrypt the API key and save it to a secure local storage solution. Outputs: Confirmation of successful storage.

Create a function to retrieve and decrypt the stored API key for use. Inputs: None. Transformation: Access the local storage, decrypt the API key, and make it available for application use. Outputs: Decrypted API key.

Implement a UI indicator to show the presence of the API key. Inputs: Status of API key presence (exists or not). Transformation: Set the UI indicator to green if the API key is present and red if it is not. Outputs: Visual indicator on the UI.

Develop a guide within the UI for obtaining an OpenAI API key. Inputs: None. Transformation: Create a help section or tooltip that provides step-by-step instructions for obtaining an OpenAI API key. Outputs: UI guide for users.

Test the entire API key management feature for functionality and security. Inputs: Test cases for UI interaction, storage, and retrieval. E004.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want the system to ask clarifying questions based on missing information so that I can provide complete and accurate inputs.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system generates AI-driven questions to capture missing information.
User responses are logged in a conversation log stored locally.
The AI continues to prompt until sufficient information is collected.

Tasks.Description: Develop a function `generate_clarifying_questions` that takes as input a partially filled data structure representing user inputs. The function should use the OpenAI API to identify missing information and generate AI-driven questions. The output should be a list of questions aimed at eliciting the missing information.

Create a function `log_user_responses` that accepts user responses and a unique conversation identifier as inputs. The function should append each response to a local conversation log file, ensuring that the log is structured in a way that each entry is timestamped and associated with the correct conversation.

Implement a function `check_information_sufficiency` that takes the current state of user inputs as input and returns a boolean indicating whether sufficient information has been collected. This function should define criteria for 'sufficient information' based on predefined requirements.

Design a function `prompt_user_until_complete` that orchestrates the interaction with the user. It should repeatedly call `generate_clarifying_questions`, present these questions to the user, capture the user's responses, log them using `log_user_responses`, and check for sufficiency using `check_information_sufficiency`. The function should terminate once sufficient information is collected, returning the complete set of user inputs.

Develop a function `initialize_conversation_log` that sets up the local storage for conversation logs. This function should create a new log file or database entry for each new session, ensuring that logs are organized and easily retrievable.

E004.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want the system to transform my captured intent into structured artifacts through defined stages so that I can have a detailed execution plan.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system processes intents through stages: Vision → Requirements → Stakeholders/Phases → Epics → Stories → Tasks.
Each stage is clearly defined and outputs are stored locally.
Tasks are scored for complexity and effort.

Tasks.Description: Create a function `process_intent_to_vision` that takes an input of raw intent data (string) and transforms it into a structured vision statement (string). The function should output the vision statement and store it in a local file named `vision_stage.json`.

Develop a function `vision_to_requirements` that accepts a vision statement (string) as input and generates a list of requirements (list of strings). The output should be stored in a local file named `requirements_stage.json`.

Implement a function `requirements_to_stakeholders_phases` that takes a list of requirements (list of strings) as input and identifies relevant stakeholders and project phases (dictionary with stakeholders as keys and phases as values). Store the output in a local file named `stakeholders_phases_stage.json`.

Create a function `stakeholders_phases_to_epics` that uses the stakeholders and phases data (dictionary) to generate epics (list of strings). The function should output the epics and store them in a local file named `epics_stage.json`.

Develop a function `epics_to_stories` that takes a list of epics (list of strings) and breaks them down into user stories (list of dictionaries with 'epic' and 'story' keys). The output should be stored in a local file named `stories_stage.json`.

Implement a function `stories_to_tasks` that accepts a list of user stories (list of dictionaries) and decomposes each story into detailed tasks (list of dictionaries with 'story' and 'task' keys). The output should be stored in a local file named `tasks_stage.json`.

Create a function `score_tasks` that takes a list of tasks (list of dictionaries) and assigns a complexity and effort score to each task (dictionary with 'task', 'complexity_score', and 'effort_score' keys). The scored tasks should be stored in a local file named `scored_tasks.json`.

E004.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to review and edit intermediate artifacts locally so that I can ensure accuracy before finalizing proposals.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system provides local UI options to review intermediate artifacts.
Users can edit artifacts before they are finalized.
Changes are saved and reflected in the final outputs.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a local user interface (UI) using Python and a suitable desktop application framework (e.g., PyQt or Tkinter) to display intermediate artifacts. Inputs: Intermediate artifacts data. Transformation: Render data in a user-friendly format. Outputs: Displayed artifacts in the UI.

Develop a function to load intermediate artifacts from a local storage system. Inputs: File path or database query parameters. Transformation: Retrieve and deserialize data into a structured format. Outputs: Structured data representing intermediate artifacts.

Create an edit functionality within the UI that allows users to modify the displayed artifacts. Inputs: User input from UI components (e.g., text fields, dropdowns). Transformation: Update the in-memory representation of the artifacts. Outputs: Modified artifacts data.

Implement a save function that persists changes made to the artifacts back to local storage. Inputs: Modified artifacts data. Transformation: Serialize and write data to a file or database. Outputs: Confirmation of successful data persistence.

Develop a function to synchronize changes from the local storage to the final output system. Inputs: Modified artifacts data from local storage. Transformation: Update the final output system with the latest artifact data. Outputs: Updated final outputs reflecting changes.

Integrate a review mechanism that highlights changes made to the artifacts for user confirmation before finalizing. Inputs: Original and modified artifacts data. Transformation: Compare and highlight differences. Outputs: Visual indication of changes in the UI.

Implement error handling and validation checks to ensure data integrity during the edit and save processes. Inputs: User inputs and modified data. Transformation: Validate inputs and check for errors. Outputs: Error messages or confirmation of valid data.

E004.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to generate proposal drafts and export them to various formats so that I can share and utilize them effectively.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system compiles outputs into proposal drafts.
Users can export outputs to PDF and Excel formats.
All outputs are stored locally for easy access.

Tasks.Description: Develop a function `generate_proposal_draft(data: dict) -> str` that takes a dictionary containing structured artifact data and compiles it into a formatted proposal draft as a string. The function should ensure the draft includes all necessary sections and information derived from the input data.

Implement a function `export_to_pdf(proposal_draft: str, file_path: str) -> None` that takes a proposal draft string and a file path, then converts the draft into a PDF document saved at the specified location. Utilize a PDF generation library to handle the conversion and formatting.

Create a function `export_to_excel(proposal_draft: str, file_path: str) -> None` that converts the proposal draft string into an Excel file. The function should organize the draft content into appropriate Excel cells and save the file at the given path using an Excel handling library.

Develop a function `store_locally(file_path: str, content: bytes) -> None` that saves the given content (PDF or Excel) to the local file system at the specified file path. Ensure the function handles file writing and error checking for file system operations.

Integrate the above functions into a cohesive module `proposal_exporter` that orchestrates the generation, export, and local storage of proposal drafts. The module should provide a user-friendly interface for triggering the draft generation and export process, ensuring all outputs meet the acceptance criteria.

E005.Epic Description: Design a system to store JSON artifacts locally and provide options for exporting proposal drafts and other outputs to formats like PDF or Excel. Include local UIs for reviewing or editing intermediate artifacts.
E005.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to store JSON artifacts locally so that I can access and manage my proposal data offline.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system must save JSON artifacts to a specified local directory.
Users can specify or change the directory location for storing JSON artifacts.
The system should notify the user upon successful storage of a JSON artifact.

Tasks.Description: Create a function `save_json_artifact` that takes inputs: `json_data` (the JSON artifact to be saved) and `directory_path` (the directory where the JSON artifact should be saved). The function should transform the `json_data` into a JSON file and save it to the specified `directory_path`. The output should be a boolean indicating success or failure of the save operation.

Develop a function `set_directory_path` that allows users to specify or change the directory location for storing JSON artifacts. The input should be a new `directory_path`, and the function should update a configuration file or setting with this path. The output should confirm the update of the directory path.

Implement a function `notify_user` that takes an input `message` (a string) and displays this message to the user. This function should be used to notify the user upon successful storage of a JSON artifact. The output is the display of the notification message to the user.

Integrate the `save_json_artifact`, `set_directory_path`, and `notify_user` functions into a cohesive workflow. This workflow should first check if the directory path is set, then save the JSON artifact using `save_json_artifact`, and finally call `notify_user` to inform the user of the successful operation. The output should be a user notification upon successful completion of the save operation.

Create a user interface component that allows users to interact with the `set_directory_path` function. This component should provide an input field for the directory path and a button to save the new path. The output should be a confirmation message displayed to the user upon successful update of the directory path.

E005.Epic Description: Design a system to store JSON artifacts locally and provide options for exporting proposal drafts and other outputs to formats like PDF or Excel. Include local UIs for reviewing or editing intermediate artifacts.
E005.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to export proposal drafts to PDF format so that I can share finalized documents easily.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system provides an option to export proposal drafts to PDF format.
Exported PDFs should maintain the formatting and structure of the proposal.
Users receive a confirmation message upon successful export.

Tasks.Description: Create a function `convert_to_pdf` that takes a JSON object representing a proposal draft as input. This function will transform the JSON data into a formatted PDF document. The output will be a PDF file that maintains the original formatting and structure of the proposal.

Develop a function `export_pdf` that accepts a PDF document and a file path as inputs. This function will save the PDF document to the specified file path on the local system. The output will be a saved PDF file accessible to the user.

Implement a function `notify_user` that takes a success flag and a message string as inputs. This function will display a confirmation message to the user upon successful export of the PDF. The output will be a user interface notification confirming the export.

Design a user interface component `export_button` that triggers the `convert_to_pdf` and `export_pdf` functions when clicked. The input will be the user's interaction with the button, and the output will be the initiation of the PDF export process.

Integrate the `notify_user` function with the `export_pdf` function to ensure that a confirmation message is displayed to the user upon successful export. The input will be the result of the `export_pdf` function, and the output will be a user notification.

Create a test suite `test_pdf_export` that verifies the functionality of the `convert_to_pdf`, `export_pdf`, and `notify_user` functions. The inputs will be various JSON proposal drafts, and the outputs will be assertions confirming the correct PDF formatting, successful file saving, and accurate user notifications.

E005.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to export outputs to Excel format so that I can analyze and manipulate data using spreadsheet tools.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system provides an option to export outputs to Excel format.
Exported Excel files should include all relevant data fields and maintain data integrity.
Users receive a confirmation message upon successful export.

Tasks.Description: Create a function 'export_to_excel' that takes JSON data as input, transforms it into a pandas DataFrame, and outputs an Excel file. Ensure that all relevant data fields from the JSON are included in the DataFrame.

Implement a function 'validate_data_integrity' that checks the integrity of data before exporting. This function should take the transformed DataFrame as input and ensure that no data is lost or altered during the transformation process. Output should be a boolean indicating data integrity status.

Develop a function 'save_excel_file' that takes the DataFrame and a file path as inputs and writes the DataFrame to an Excel file at the specified location. Ensure that the file is saved in a user-friendly format.

Create a function 'notify_user' that sends a confirmation message to the user upon successful export. This function should take the file path as input and output a message indicating the success of the export operation.

Design a local UI component 'ExportToExcelUI' that allows users to initiate the export process. This component should provide options for users to select the data they wish to export and specify the file path for the Excel file.

Integrate the 'export_to_excel', 'validate_data_integrity', 'save_excel_file', and 'notify_user' functions into the UI component, ensuring a seamless user experience from data selection to confirmation of export.

E005.Epic Description: Design a system to store JSON artifacts locally and provide options for exporting proposal drafts and other outputs to formats like PDF or Excel. Include local UIs for reviewing or editing intermediate artifacts.
E005.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to review intermediate artifacts so that I can ensure accuracy and completeness before finalizing proposals.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system provides a UI for viewing intermediate artifacts.
Users can navigate through different stages of the proposal process to review artifacts.
Users can see a summary of changes made to each artifact.

Tasks.Description: Create a function `load_intermediate_artifacts` that takes a file path as input, reads JSON artifacts from the local storage, and returns the artifacts as a Python dictionary. This function will be used to load data for the UI.

Develop a function `generate_artifact_summary` that accepts a dictionary of artifacts as input, processes the data to identify changes made to each artifact, and returns a summary dictionary containing details of these changes. This will help users understand modifications at a glance.

Implement a Flask route `view_artifacts` that calls `load_intermediate_artifacts` and `generate_artifact_summary`, and renders a template displaying the artifacts and their summaries. This route will serve the UI for reviewing artifacts.

Design a Flask template `artifacts_review.html` that takes the artifacts and their summaries as context variables. The template should provide a user interface for navigating through different stages of the proposal process and reviewing each artifact.

Create a function `navigate_artifacts` that takes the current artifact index and a navigation command ('next' or 'previous') as inputs, and returns the index of the next artifact to be displayed. This function will enable users to move through the proposal stages.

Develop a JavaScript function `updateArtifactView` that listens for navigation commands from the UI, calls the `navigate_artifacts` function via an AJAX request, and updates the displayed artifact and summary without refreshing the page.

Set up a Flask endpoint `artifact_changes` that returns a JSON response with the summary of changes for a specific artifact when requested. This will be used by the JavaScript function to update the UI dynamically.

E005.Epic Description: Design a system to store JSON artifacts locally and provide options for exporting proposal drafts and other outputs to formats like PDF or Excel. Include local UIs for reviewing or editing intermediate artifacts.
E005.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to edit intermediate artifacts so that I can make necessary adjustments to the proposal content.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system provides a UI for editing intermediate artifacts.
Users can make changes to text, add comments, and update data fields.
The system tracks changes and allows users to revert to previous versions if needed.

Tasks.Description: Develop a function `load_intermediate_artifact` that takes an artifact ID as input and retrieves the corresponding JSON artifact from the local storage. The function should return the artifact data in a structured format suitable for editing.

Create a function `render_editing_ui` that takes the artifact data as input and generates a user interface for editing. The UI should allow users to modify text, add comments, and update data fields. The output should be a rendered UI component that can be integrated into the desktop application.

Implement a function `apply_edits_to_artifact` that accepts edited artifact data and the original artifact ID as inputs. This function should update the local storage with the new changes and return a success or failure status.

Design a function `track_changes` that logs all changes made to an artifact. The function should take the artifact ID and a list of changes as inputs, and store these changes in a version control system. The output should be a confirmation of successful logging.

Develop a function `revert_to_previous_version` that allows users to revert an artifact to a previous version. The function should take the artifact ID and a version identifier as inputs, retrieve the specified version from the version control system, and update the local storage with this version. The output should be the reverted artifact data.

E005.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to be notified of available export options so that I can choose the best format for my needs.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system displays available export options (PDF, Excel) prominently in the UI.
Users receive guidance on when to use each export format.
The system provides tooltips or help sections explaining the export process.

Tasks.Description: Design a UI component in the desktop application to display export options. Input: None. Transformation: Create a UI element that prominently lists available export formats (PDF, Excel) on the main interface. Output: A UI component that displays export options.

Implement a function to trigger notifications for available export options. Input: User interaction event (e.g., clicking a 'Export' button). Transformation: Upon triggering, display a notification or modal with export options. Output: Notification/modal displaying export options (PDF, Excel).

Develop a guidance system for export format selection. Input: User selection of an export option. Transformation: Provide contextual guidance or recommendations on when to use each format based on user needs. Output: Displayed guidance message or tooltip.

Create tooltips or help sections explaining the export process. Input: User hover or click action on export options. Transformation: Display detailed explanations or steps involved in the export process. Output: Tooltip or help section with export process information.

Integrate the export options UI with backend logic to handle export requests. Input: User selection of export format. Transformation: Call backend functions to process and export data in the chosen format. Output: Exported file in the selected format (PDF or Excel).

Test the export options UI and functionality to ensure compliance with acceptance criteria. Input: Test cases based on acceptance criteria. Transformation: Execute tests to verify that export options are displayed prominently, guidance is provided, and tooltips/help sections are functional. Output: Test results indicating compliance or areas for improvement.

E006.Epic Description: Ensure the software functions as a self-contained offline workflow, starting from voice or text input and ending with structured plans and proposal outputs. Optimize the system for efficient processing and responsiveness.
E006.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to speak my vision into the system and have it transcribed into text so that I can easily review and edit my input before submission.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system provides a voice input feature that transcribes speech into text in real-time.
The transcribed text is displayed in an editable text area.
The CREATOR can stop, edit, and submit the transcribed text.

Tasks.Description: Develop a function 'capture_voice_input' that captures audio input from the user's microphone. Input: None. Transformation: Utilize Python libraries to access the microphone and capture audio data. Output: Raw audio data stream.

Implement a function 'transcribe_audio_to_text' that takes raw audio data as input and converts it into text using the OpenAI API for NLP processing. Input: Raw audio data stream. Transformation: Send audio data to OpenAI API for transcription. Output: Transcribed text string.

Create a function 'display_transcribed_text' that receives the transcribed text and displays it in an editable text area within the desktop application. Input: Transcribed text string. Transformation: Render text in a GUI text area using a Python GUI library. Output: Editable text area populated with transcribed text.

Develop a function 'edit_text_content' that allows the user to make changes to the transcribed text within the text area. Input: User interactions (keyboard/mouse events). Transformation: Update the text area content based on user input. Output: Updated transcribed text string.

Implement a function 'submit_transcribed_text' that allows the user to submit the edited text for further processing. Input: Edited transcribed text string. Transformation: Validate and prepare text for submission. Output: Confirmation of submission and storage of the final text.

Create a function 'stop_transcription' that allows the user to stop the voice input process at any time. Input: User action (button press). Transformation: Terminate audio capture and processing. Output: Stops transcription and retains the last transcribed text.

E006.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want to manage my OpenAI API key within the application so that I can ensure all AI calls are authenticated and functional.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The UI provides a clear path for obtaining and entering an OpenAI API key.
The system stores the API key locally and securely.
The UI indicates the presence of the API key with a red/green state indicator.

Tasks.Description: Design a UI component in the desktop application that allows users to input their OpenAI API key. The function should take user input as a string and validate it against a basic format check (e.g., length, character set). Output should be a boolean indicating whether the input is valid.

Implement a secure storage mechanism for the OpenAI API key. The function should take the API key as input and store it using encryption (e.g., using a library like cryptography). The output should be a confirmation message indicating successful storage or an error message if storage fails.

Develop a function to retrieve the stored API key from local storage. The function should decrypt the stored key and return it as a string. If retrieval fails, the function should output an error message.

Create a UI indicator that reflects the presence and validity of the API key. The function should take the validation status (boolean) as input and update the UI with a red (invalid) or green (valid) state indicator. No output is required beyond the UI update.

Integrate the API key management functions with the main application workflow. Ensure that all OpenAI API calls use the stored API key. The function should take the API key as input and return a response from the OpenAI API, handling any authentication errors appropriately.
Write unit tests for each function to ensure they handle valid and invalid inputs correctly. Each test should provide inputs, expected outputs, and assert that the function behaves as expected.

E006.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want the system to ask clarifying questions based on my input so that I can provide all necessary information for proposal generation.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system generates AI-driven prompts to ask clarifying questions.
User responses are logged in a conversation log stored locally.
The system continues to ask questions until sufficient information is collected.

Tasks.Description: Develop a function `generate_clarifying_questions(input_text)` that takes user input as a string and uses the OpenAI API to generate AI-driven prompts for clarifying questions. The function should return a list of question strings.

Create a function `log_user_response(conversation_log, user_response)` that takes the current conversation log (a list of strings) and the user's response (a string) as inputs. Append the user's response to the conversation log and save it locally as a JSON file. The function should return the updated conversation log.

Implement a function `is_information_sufficient(conversation_log)` that analyzes the conversation log to determine if enough information has been collected to generate a proposal. This function should return a boolean value indicating sufficiency.

Design a function `ask_questions_until_sufficient(input_text)` that orchestrates the process by calling `generate_clarifying_questions`, `log_user_response`, and `is_information_sufficient` in a loop. It should continue asking questions and logging responses until `is_information_sufficient` returns true. The function should return the final conversation log.

Develop a function `save_conversation_log(conversation_log, file_path)` that takes the conversation log and a file path as inputs and saves the log to the specified local file path in JSON format. This function should not return any value.

E006.Epic Description: Ensure the software functions as a self-contained offline workflow, starting from voice or text input and ending with structured plans and proposal outputs. Optimize the system for efficient processing and responsiveness.
E006.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want my captured intent to be transformed into structured artifacts so that I can receive detailed execution plans.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system transforms captured intents through stages: Vision → Requirements → Stakeholders/Phases → Epics → Stories → Tasks.
Tasks are scored for complexity and effort.
Structured artifacts are compiled into proposal outputs.

Tasks.Description: Develop a function `capture_intent(input_data)` that takes `input_data` as a string (voice or text) and preprocesses it for transformation. The function should output a cleaned and standardized text format ready for further processing.

Create a function `transform_vision_to_requirements(intent_text)` that takes `intent_text` as input and uses the OpenAI API to transform the vision into a list of high-level requirements. The output should be a structured list of requirements.

Implement a function `identify_stakeholders_and_phases(requirements_list)` that accepts the `requirements_list` and maps each requirement to relevant stakeholders and project phases. The output should be a dictionary with stakeholders as keys and associated phases as values.

Design a function `generate_epics(stakeholders_phases_dict)` that takes the `stakeholders_phases_dict` and generates epics for each stakeholder-phase pair. The output should be a list of epics with associated stakeholders and phases.
Develop a function `create_stories_from_epics(epics_list)` that accepts the `epics_list` and breaks down each epic into user stories. The output should be a list of stories with associated epics.

Create a function `decompose_stories_into_tasks(stories_list)` that takes the `stories_list` and decomposes each story into detailed tasks. The output should be a list of tasks with associated stories.

Implement a function `score_tasks_for_complexity_and_effort(tasks_list)` that takes the `tasks_list` and assigns a complexity and effort score to each task based on predefined criteria. The output should be a list of tasks with associated scores.

Develop a function `compile_structured_artifacts(tasks_list)` that takes the `tasks_list` with scores and compiles them into structured artifacts. The output should be a comprehensive proposal document that includes all tasks, scores, and associated details.

E006.Epic Description: Ensure the software functions as a self-contained offline workflow, starting from voice or text input and ending with structured plans and proposal outputs. Optimize the system for efficient processing and responsiveness.
E006.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want my proposal artifacts to be stored locally so that I can access and manage them offline.
Story Acceptance Criteria: JSON artifacts are stored locally on the system.
The system provides options to export outputs to PDF or Excel.
Local UIs are available for reviewing or editing intermediate artifacts.

Tasks.Description: Develop a function `store_json_locally` that takes JSON data as input and writes it to a local file system. The function should accept parameters for the file name and directory path, and output a confirmation message upon successful storage.
Create a function `export_to_pdf` that accepts JSON data as input and converts it into a formatted PDF document. The function should output the PDF file stored locally and return the file path.
Implement a function `export_to_excel` that takes JSON data as input and transforms it into an Excel spreadsheet. The function should output the Excel file stored locally and return the file path.

Design a local user interface `review_artifacts_ui` that allows users to load and display JSON artifacts stored locally. The UI should provide options to view, edit, and save changes back to the local file system.

Develop a function `edit_json_artifact` that allows modifications to a loaded JSON object. The function should take a JSON object and a set of changes as input, apply the changes, and output the updated JSON object.

E006.Story Description: As a CREATOR, I want the system to process my inputs efficiently and respond promptly so that I can have a seamless and productive experience.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system processes voice inputs and generates AI-driven prompts without noticeable delays.
The system efficiently transforms intents into structured proposals.
The overall workflow is optimized for responsiveness and user experience.

Tasks.Description: Develop a function `process_voice_input` that takes a voice input file as input, converts it to text using a speech-to-text service, and returns the transcribed text. Input: audio file; Output: transcribed text.

Create a function `generate_ai_prompt` that accepts text input, processes it using the OpenAI API to generate AI-driven prompts, and returns the generated prompt. Input: text; Output: AI-generated prompt.

Implement a function `transform_intent_to_proposal` that takes an AI-generated prompt as input, analyzes the intent using NLP transformers, and outputs a structured proposal. Input: AI-generated prompt; Output: structured proposal.

Design a function `optimize_workflow` that orchestrates the entire process from voice input to structured proposal, ensuring minimal latency and efficient processing. This function should call `process_voice_input`, `generate_ai_prompt`, and `transform_intent_to_proposal` in sequence, and return the final proposal. Input: audio file; Output: structured proposal.

Develop a function `evaluate_response_time` that measures the time taken for each step in the workflow and logs performance metrics to ensure responsiveness. Input: None; Output: performance metrics log.

Create a function `user_experience_feedback` that collects user feedback on the system's responsiveness and efficiency, analyzes the feedback, and outputs suggestions for improvement. Input: user feedback; Output: improvement suggestions.
